text.title: Regression Test First Bugfix Workflow — Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the workflow record one bugfix produces: the alert with its observed outcome and payload-derived reproducing inputs, the red test (committed under tests/regression/ with its failing CI run, or pending with a follow-up ticket due within 14 days), the fix with its first commit and diff size, the green CI run, the named developer, and the review at merge plus 90 days against the alert's regression status. Validator in scripts/validate-regression-test-first-bugfix-workflow.py enforces it, including the date arithmetic.

required.field: `kind`, `url`, `alert_id`, `observed_outcome` (`kind` = `exception` or `wrong-output` plus the exact type/message fragment or value), `reproducing_inputs` lifted from the alert payload, optional `side_effect` and `pii_substitutions[]`, `deterministic: true` (r-inputs-lifted-from-alert-payload, r-test-fails-for-the-alerts-reason)

`status: committed` with `path` under `tests/regression/`, `commit`, `commit_message_has_alert_url: true`, `asserts[]` on the alert's outcome, `side_effect_asserts[]` when the bug had a side effect, `red_ci_run_url` of the failing run, `failure_matches_alert: true`, `stable_runs` of at least 3; or `status: pending` with `follow_up_ticket_url` and `due_at` (r-red-test-committed-before-fix, r-test-is-deterministic-and-located, r-hotfix-variant-carries-follow-up)

`pr_url`, `first_fix_commit` (must differ from and descend from `red_test.commit`), `diff_lines`, `touches_red_test_assertions: false`, `hotfix` flag, optional `refactor_pr_url` (r-fix-is-minimal-and-assertions-untouched)
`ci_run_url` of the complete PR, `passed: true` taken from CI output, `skipped_or_xfail: false` (r-ci-shows-red-then-green)
the developer who owns the fix, `role:handle` (Human checkpoint in 03-failure-modes.xml)

`merged_at`, `next_review_at` = `merged_at` + 90 days, `alert_resolved`, and at the review an `outcome` with `regression_events_in_window` and `same_signature_new_issue` (r-alert-closed-after-recurrence-window)

forbidden.pattern: `red_test.commit` equal to `fix.first_fix_commit`, or a red test with no `red_ci_run_url` — fm-test-written-after-fix
an `asserts[]` item of the form `raises(Exception)`, or `failure_matches_alert: false` — fm-fails-for-wrong-reason
`reproducing_inputs` empty, or inputs not present in the alert payload — fm-invented-repro-inputs
`red_test.status: pending` with no `follow_up_ticket_url`, with `due_at` more than 14 days after `review.merged_at`, or with `review.alert_resolved: true` — fm-hotfix-follow-up-forgotten

list.item: `red_test.commit` differs from `fix.first_fix_commit`, is its ancestor in git, the commit message carries the alert URL, and `red_ci_run_url` shows the test failing (r-red-test-committed-before-fix).
`asserts[]` names the alert's exception type and message fragment or the wrong value; `side_effect_asserts[]` is non-empty whenever `alert.side_effect` is set (r-test-fails-for-the-alerts-reason).
Every key in `reproducing_inputs` came from the alert payload; replaced personal data is listed in `pii_substitutions[]` (r-inputs-lifted-from-alert-payload).
`path` is under `tests/regression/`, the test's docstring carries `alert_id`, and the same commit passed and failed consistently across `stable_runs` >= 3 (r-test-is-deterministic-and-located).
`diff_lines` is recorded, refactors are in `refactor_pr_url`, and `touches_red_test_assertions` is false (r-fix-is-minimal-and-assertions-untouched).
`verification.ci_run_url` is the complete PR's run, `passed` was read from CI, and `skipped_or_xfail` is false (r-ci-shows-red-then-green).
A pending red test has a follow-up ticket URL, `due_at` no later than `merged_at` + 14 days, and `alert_resolved: false` (r-hotfix-variant-carries-follow-up).
`next_review_at` equals `merged_at` + 90 days; at the review `outcome` cites the alert's regression count and any same-signature issue (r-alert-closed-after-recurrence-window).
